Purpose\n\nThis notebook is the audit-ready record of **Edge Quantum Guard**: a pre-job control stack that\n\n1. observes device health from **published calibration** (0 QPU seconds),\n2. selects a conflict-aware physical layout (**Layout Guard**),\n3. decides whether to inject Dynamical Decoupling (**Conditional DD / adrenaline**),\n4. runs a **demanding open Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM)** workload on the **real QPU**, and only then\n5. authorizes an unassisted baseline if pre-registered success criteria are met.\n\nShareable outputs (`report.json`, `results_summary.txt`, `figures_summary.png`) carry metrics and plots so results can be communicated **without** distributing internal control logic.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Scientific rationale\n\nOn NISQ processors, circuit quality depends strongly on which physical qubits are used and whether idle-time decoherence is mitigated. Spending quantum processing unit (QPU) time on an unassisted baseline *before* knowing whether the assisted path is viable wastes limited quota when the assisted path already fails.\n\nA trivial arithmetic circuit does not stress the device. This protocol therefore uses a **Quantum Support Vector Machine**: classical data are mapped into a quantum feature space via a parameterized feature map; pairwise state fidelities form a quantum kernel; a classical SVM is trained on that kernel. Kernel estimation is gate-heavy, entanglement-rich, and sensitive to noise — a realistic stability test for production-oriented QPU use.\n\n**Gated expenditure policy (30-second hard ceiling)**\n\n```text\nArm B — EQG protocol + QSVM          ≤ 15 s account\n        │\n        ▼\n   pre-registered favorability gate\n        │ yes                              │ no\n        ▼                                  ▼\nArm A — same QSVM, no EQG               SKIP Arm A\n        ≤ 15 s account                    (preserve remaining ~15 s)\n```\n\n**Queue wait is not billed QPU seconds.** Open-plan queues can take minutes of wall-clock time; `JOB_TIMEOUT_S` cancels if the job has not finished within the wall limit. Account time is estimated from shots and a conservative circuit model.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Architecture (EQG modules only)\n\n| Role | EQG module | Function |\n|------|------------|----------|\n| Eyes | **Observation Membrane** | Maps relative health scores into discrete regimes (STABLE / UNSTABLE / CONFLICT) with hysteresis |\n| Reflexes | **Layout Guard** | Selects a size-`k` physical layout that prefers healthy qubits and avoids high-crosstalk pairs |\n| Hands | **Conditional DD** | Injects Dynamical Decoupling only when mean layout health is below a fixed threshold (“adrenaline”) |\n| Workload | **QSVM** (ZZFeatureMap + fidelity kernel + classical SVC) | Open ML job used as the stability test |\n\n**Real-time path:** Observation Membrane → Layout Guard → Conditional DD → QSVM kernel evaluation.\n\n**Critical separation of roles**\n\n- **Layout Guard** chooses *who* works (physical qubit set).\n- **Conditional DD** chooses *how* they work (mitigation). DD does **not** select qubits.\n- Layout selection excludes qubits from *this job’s circuit only*; it does not power-down the device.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Workload: Quantum Support Vector Machine (Apache-2.0)\n\nComponents (all Apache-2.0):\n\n| Component | Source |\n|-----------|--------|\n| `ZZFeatureMap` | Qiskit circuit library |\n| Fidelity kernel (compute–uncompute) | Pattern from `qiskit-machine-learning` / Qiskit tutorials |\n| Classical `SVC` | scikit-learn |\n\n**Pipeline**\n\n1. **Data encoding** — classical points → quantum states via `ZZFeatureMap` (2 qubits, full entanglement).\n2. **Quantum kernel evaluation** — pairwise fidelities \\(K(x_i,x_j)=|\\langle\\phi(x_i)|\\phi(x_j)\\rangle|^2\\) estimated on the **real QPU** in one batched Sampler job.\n3. **Classical SVM training** — `SVC(kernel=\"precomputed\")` on the estimated kernel matrix.\n4. **Classification metric** — accuracy on a fixed tiny hold-out set (favorability gate).\n\nSized for a **15 s** account window: 3 training points → 9 kernel circuits (full 3×3), 2 test points for accuracy, 2-qubit feature map, limited shots.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Pre-registered decisions (do not change after seeing data)\n\n| Parameter | Value | Meaning |\n|-----------|-------|---------|\n| `BUDGET_B_S` | **15** | Assisted (EQG) account ceiling |\n| `BUDGET_A_S` | **15** | Baseline ceiling (only if B favorable) |\n| `BUDGET_TOTAL_S` | **30** | Hard account limit |\n| `FAVORABLE_ACCURACY` | 0.50 | Minimum test accuracy for Arm B |\n| `HEALTH_THR` | 0.92 | Below this layout health → enable DD |\n| Feature map | ZZFeatureMap, 2 qubits, reps=1, full entanglement | Demanding relative to trivial circuits |\n| Train / test size | 3 / 2 points, 2 features | Fits 15 s kernel batch |\n| `SHOTS_PER_PAIR` | 128 | Per fidelity circuit |\n| `JOB_TIMEOUT_S` | 180 | Wall wait for queue+run; then cancel |\n\n---\n\n## 6. Execution phases\n\n| Phase | Cell | Content | QPU account |\n|-------|------|---------|-------------|\n| **1** | Cell 1 | Install, EQG stack, QSVM builders, real-QPU connection | 0 s |\n| **2** | Cell 2 | Arm B — EQG + QSVM kernel job | ≤ **15 s** |\n| **3** | Cell 3 | Arm A — QSVM alone (conditional) | ≤ **15 s** |\n| **4** | Cell 4 | Tables, verdict, report, graphs | 0 s |\n| — | Cell 5 | License (ELv2) | — |\n\nIf Phase 2 is not favorable, **do not run Phase 3**.","metadata":{}},{"id":"s1","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## Phase 1 — Configuration, EQG control stack, QSVM builders, real-QPU connection\n\n**Hardware only.** No CPU path, no Aer, no simulator. If the token or backend fails, execution stops.","metadata":{}},{"id":"cfg","cell_type":"code","source":"%pip install -q \"qiskit>=1.0\" \"qiskit-ibm-runtime>=0.30\" matplotlib scipy scikit-learn\n\nimport os, time, json, heapq, itertools\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional\nimport numpy as np\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nfrom sklearn.svm import SVC\n\nplt.rcParams.update({\n    \"figure.dpi\": 120, \"axes.grid\": True, \"grid.alpha\": 0.3,\n    \"axes.spines.top\": False, \"axes.spines.right\": False, \"font.size\": 10,\n})\n\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n# Edge Quantum Guard — HARDWARE ONLY — 15 s + 15 s = 30 s\n# Workload: QSVM (ZZFeatureMap + fidelity kernel + SVC)\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\nCHANNEL = \"ibm_cloud\"\nINSTANCE = \"open-instance\"\nBACKEND_NAME = \"ibm_fez\"\nUSE_LEAST_BUSY = False\n\nBUDGET_TOTAL_S = 30.0\nBUDGET_B_S = 15.0\nBUDGET_A_S = 15.0\nJOB_TIMEOUT_S = 180\n\nN_QUBITS = 2                    # ZZFeatureMap width\nFEATURE_DIM = 2\nSHOTS_PER_PAIR = 128\nFAVORABLE_ACCURACY = 0.50\nHEALTH_THR = 0.92\n\nOUT = Path(\"/kaggle/working/eqg_qsvm\") if Path(\"/kaggle/working\").exists() else Path(\"eqg_qsvm\")\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\nt_acum = 0.0\nstate = {\n    \"project\": \"Edge Quantum Guard\",\n    \"author\": \"Arturo Salvador Balderas Hernandez\",\n    \"license\": \"Elastic-2.0\",\n    \"workload\": \"QSVM (ZZFeatureMap + fidelity kernel + SVC)\",\n    \"result_b\": None, \"result_a\": None,\n    \"favorable\": False, \"fav_reason\": \"\",\n    \"layout_b\": None, \"use_dd\": False,\n    \"health\": {}, \"flags\": {},\n    \"backend\": None, \"job_ids\": [],\n}\n\ndef token() -> str:\n    try:\n        from kaggle_secrets import UserSecretsClient\n        t = UserSecretsClient().get_secret(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\n        if t:\n            return t.strip()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    t = os.environ.get(\"QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN\") or os.environ.get(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\n    if not t:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"HARDWARE ONLY: set IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN. No simulator.\")\n    return t.strip()\n\n# ─── Fixed QSVM dataset (pre-registered, reproducible) ───\n# 3 train + 2 test, 2 features, binary labels — sized for 15 s kernel batch\nX_TRAIN = np.array([\n    [0.20, 0.35],\n    [0.80, 0.75],\n    [0.25, 0.70],\n], dtype=float)\nY_TRAIN = np.array([0, 1, 0], dtype=int)\nX_TEST = np.array([\n    [0.30, 0.40],\n    [0.70, 0.80],\n], dtype=float)\nY_TEST = np.array([0, 1], dtype=int)\n\n# ─── EQG: Observation Membrane ───\nclass ObservationMembrane:\n    \"\"\"Hysteresis: relative anomaly → STABLE / UNSTABLE / CONFLICT.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 13):\n        self.cap = max(8, min(int(capacity), 64))\n        self.h: List[float] = []\n        self.state = 0\n\n    def push(self, score: float) -> int:\n        self.h.append(float(score))\n        self.h = self.h[-self.cap:]\n        sm = float(np.mean(self.h))\n        if self.state == 0:\n            if sm >= 0.42: self.state = 1\n        elif self.state == 1:\n            if sm >= 0.68: self.state = 2\n            elif sm < 0.35: self.state = 0\n        else:\n            if sm < 0.58: self.state = 1\n        return self.state\n\nREGIME = [\"STABLE\", \"UNSTABLE\", \"CONFLICT\"]\n\n# ─── EQG: Layout Guard ───\ndef _make_adj(n, edges):\n    adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]\n    for u, v in edges:\n        adj[u].add(v); adj[v].add(u)\n    return adj\n\ndef _weighted_independent_set(adj, w):\n    n = len(adj); rd = [len(a) for a in adj]; alive = [True] * n\n    heap = [(-w[v] / (rd[v] + 1), v) for v in range(n)]\n    heapq.heapify(heap); S = []\n    while heap:\n        key, v = heapq.heappop(heap)\n        if not alive[v] or abs(-key - w[v] / (rd[v] + 1)) > 1e-12:\n            continue\n        S.append(v); alive[v] = False\n        for u in adj[v]:\n            if not alive[u]: continue\n            alive[u] = False\n            for x in adj[u]:\n                if alive[x]:\n                    rd[x] -= 1\n                    heapq.heappush(heap, (-w[x] / (rd[x] + 1), x))\n    return S\n\ndef _local_improve(adj, S0):\n    S = set(S0); changed = True\n    while changed:\n        changed = False\n        for u in list(S):\n            if u not in S: continue\n            cand = [v for v in adj[u] if v not in S and len(adj[v] & S) == 1]\n            for i, v in enumerate(cand):\n                ww = next((w for w in cand[i + 1:] if w not in adj[v]), None)\n                if ww is not None:\n                    S.discard(u); S |= {v, ww}; changed = True; break\n            if changed: break\n    return sorted(S)\n\ndef layout_guard(candidates, health, flags, zz_pairs, k, zz_thr=2.0):\n    \"\"\"Who works: prefer healthy qubits, avoid high-crosstalk edges.\"\"\"\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    pool = [q for q in candidates if flags.get(q, 0) == 0] or list(candidates)\n    if len(pool) < k:\n        rest = sorted([q for q in candidates if q not in pool],\n                      key=lambda q: (flags.get(q, 0), -health.get(q, 0)))\n        pool += rest[: k - len(pool)]\n    idx = {q: i for i, q in enumerate(pool)}\n    edges = [(idx[a], idx[b]) for (a, b), z in zz_pairs.items()\n             if a in idx and b in idx and z >= zz_thr]\n    adj = _make_adj(len(pool), edges)\n    w = [float(health.get(q, 0.5)) for q in pool]\n    I = _local_improve(adj, _weighted_independent_set(adj, w))\n    chosen = sorted([pool[i] for i in I], key=lambda q: -health.get(q, 0))[:k]\n    if len(chosen) < k:\n        rest = [q for q in pool if q not in chosen]\n        while len(chosen) < k and rest:\n            chosen.append(rest.pop(0))\n    return sorted(chosen), (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1e3\n\ndef decide_dd(layout_health: float) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"How they work: mitigate only; does not change the layout.\"\"\"\n    if layout_health < HEALTH_THR:\n        return True, f\"adrenaline(health={layout_health:.3f}<{HEALTH_THR})\"\n    return False, f\"skip(health={layout_health:.3f}>={HEALTH_THR})\"\n\n# ─── QSVM circuit builders (Apache-2.0 pattern) ───\nfrom qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile\nfrom qiskit.circuit.library import ZZFeatureMap\nfrom qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService, SamplerV2\n\ndef make_feature_map() -> ZZFeatureMap:\n    return ZZFeatureMap(feature_dimension=FEATURE_DIM, reps=1, entanglement=\"full\")\n\ndef fidelity_circuit(x_i: np.ndarray, x_j: np.ndarray, use_dd: bool = False) -> QuantumCircuit:\n    \"\"\"Compute–uncompute fidelity circuit for K(x_i, x_j).\"\"\"\n    fm = make_feature_map()\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(N_QUBITS, N_QUBITS)\n    qc.compose(fm.assign_parameters(x_i), inplace=True)\n    qc.compose(fm.assign_parameters(x_j).inverse(), inplace=True)\n    if use_dd:\n        qc.x(range(N_QUBITS))\n        qc.barrier()\n        qc.x(range(N_QUBITS))\n        qc.barrier()\n    qc.measure(range(N_QUBITS), range(N_QUBITS))\n    return qc\n\ndef build_kernel_pubs(X: np.ndarray, use_dd: bool) -> List[QuantumCircuit]:\n    \"\"\"All pairwise fidelity circuits for an n×n kernel (includes diagonal).\"\"\"\n    n = len(X)\n    pubs = []\n    for i, j in itertools.product(range(n), repeat=2):\n        pubs.append(fidelity_circuit(X[i], X[j], use_dd=use_dd))\n    return pubs\n\ndef counts_to_fidelity(counts: dict) -> float:\n    \"\"\"P(all-zero) ≈ |⟨φ(x)|φ(y)⟩|² under compute–uncompute.\"\"\"\n    total = sum(counts.values()) or 1\n    zeros = 0\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        bits = str(bs).replace(\" \", \"\")\n        if set(bits) <= {\"0\"}:\n            zeros += c\n    return float(zeros / total)\n\ndef kernel_from_count_list(count_list: List[dict], n: int) -> np.ndarray:\n    K = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)\n    idx = 0\n    for i in range(n):\n        for j in range(n):\n            K[i, j] = counts_to_fidelity(count_list[idx])\n            idx += 1\n    # Symmetrize for numerical stability\n    K = 0.5 * (K + K.T)\n    np.fill_diagonal(K, np.clip(np.diag(K), 0.5, 1.0))\n    return K\n\ndef train_and_score(K_train: np.ndarray, y_train: np.ndarray,\n                    K_test_train: np.ndarray, y_test: np.ndarray) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Classical SVC on precomputed quantum kernel.\"\"\"\n    clf = SVC(kernel=\"precomputed\", C=1.0)\n    clf.fit(K_train, y_train)\n    y_pred = clf.predict(K_test_train)\n    acc = float(np.mean(y_pred == y_test))\n    return {\n        \"accuracy\": acc,\n        \"y_true\": y_test.tolist(),\n        \"y_pred\": y_pred.tolist(),\n        \"n_support\": int(clf.n_support_.sum()) if hasattr(clf, \"n_support_\") else None,\n        \"K_train_diag_mean\": float(np.mean(np.diag(K_train))),\n        \"K_train_offdiag_mean\": float((K_train.sum() - np.trace(K_train)) / max(K_train.size - len(K_train), 1)),\n    }\n\ndef is_favorable(res: Optional[dict]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n    if res is None:\n        return False, \"no result\"\n    if res[\"accuracy\"] < FAVORABLE_ACCURACY:\n        return False, f\"accuracy {res['accuracy']:.3f} < {FAVORABLE_ACCURACY}\"\n    return True, \"meets accuracy threshold\"\n\ndef estimate_account_s(n_circuits: int, shots: int) -> float:\n    return n_circuits * shots * (80e-6 + 1.6e-6 + 250e-6) + 3.0\n\n# ─── Connect to REAL hardware ───\nprint(\"Connecting to IBM Quantum — HARDWARE ONLY…\")\nservice = QiskitRuntimeService(channel=CHANNEL, token=token(), instance=INSTANCE)\n\nif USE_LEAST_BUSY:\n    backend = service.least_busy(operational=True, simulator=False, min_num_qubits=N_QUBITS)\nelse:\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    if getattr(backend.configuration(), \"simulator\", False):\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"{BACKEND_NAME} is a simulator. HARDWARE ONLY — abort.\")\n\nstate[\"backend\"] = backend.name\nn_train = len(X_TRAIN)\nn_kernel = n_train * n_train\nest = estimate_account_s(n_kernel, SHOTS_PER_PAIR)\nprint(f\"QPU: {backend.name}  qubits={backend.num_qubits}\")\nprint(f\"QSVM: ZZFeatureMap({FEATURE_DIM})  train={n_train}  kernel_circuits={n_kernel}\")\nprint(f\"Shots/pair={SHOTS_PER_PAIR}  estimated account/job ≈ {est:.2f}s\")\nprint(f\"Budgets: B≤{BUDGET_B_S:.0f}s  A≤{BUDGET_A_S:.0f}s  total≤{BUDGET_TOTAL_S:.0f}s\")\n\ndef run_kernel_job(X: np.ndarray, use_dd: bool, layout: List[int]):\n    \"\"\"ONE Sampler job: all pairwise fidelity circuits for kernel matrix.\"\"\"\n    global t_acum\n    pubs = build_kernel_pubs(X, use_dd=use_dd)\n    n_circ = len(pubs)\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    tpubs = [\n        transpile(qc, backend, initial_layout=layout, optimization_level=1)\n        for qc in pubs\n    ]\n    job = SamplerV2(mode=backend).run([(tc, None, SHOTS_PER_PAIR) for tc in tpubs])\n    jid = job.job_id()\n    state[\"job_ids\"].append(jid)\n    print(f\"  SUBMITTED job_id={jid}  circuits={n_circ}  shots/each={SHOTS_PER_PAIR}\")\n    print(f\"  Waiting on REAL QPU (wall timeout {JOB_TIMEOUT_S}s)…\")\n    print(f\"  (Queue wait ≠ billed seconds. Est. account ≈ {estimate_account_s(n_circ, SHOTS_PER_PAIR):.2f}s)\")\n    try:\n        res = job.result(timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT_S)\n    except Exception as e:\n        try:\n            job.cancel()\n            print(\"  Cancelled after timeout/error.\")\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        raise RuntimeError(\n            f\"Real QPU job failed/timeout (job_id={jid}): {e}\\n\"\n            \"Usually queue delay — retry when the backend is freer.\"\n        ) from e\n\n    count_list = []\n    for i in range(len(res)):\n        d = res[i].data\n        counts = {}\n        for key in (\"c\", \"meas\"):\n            if hasattr(d, key):\n                counts = getattr(d, key).get_counts()\n                break\n        if not counts:\n            for key in d:\n                try:\n                    counts = d[key].get_counts(); break\n                except Exception:\n                    continue\n        if not counts:\n            raise RuntimeError(f\"Empty counts from circuit {i} in job {jid}\")\n        count_list.append(counts)\n\n    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0\n    cost = estimate_account_s(n_circ, SHOTS_PER_PAIR)\n    t_acum += cost\n    print(f\"  DONE wall={wall:.1f}s  account+≈{cost:.2f}s  acum≈{t_acum:.2f}/{BUDGET_TOTAL_S:.0f}s\")\n    return count_list, wall, jid\n\ndef observe_from_calibration():\n    \"\"\"Published properties only — 0 QPU seconds.\"\"\"\n    rows = []\n    tgt = backend.target\n    for q in range(backend.num_qubits):\n        try:\n            qp = tgt.qubit_properties[q]\n            t1 = (qp.t1 or 0) * 1e6\n            t2 = (qp.t2 or 0) * 1e6\n            if t2 > 0 and t1 > 0:\n                rows.append((q, min(t2, 2 * t1)))\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    if not rows:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"No T1/T2 calibration on this backend.\")\n    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r[1])\n    cand = [r[0] for r in rows[:16]]\n    med = float(np.median([r[1] for r in rows[:24]]))\n    health, flags = {}, {}\n    for q, t2 in [(r[0], r[1]) for r in rows if r[0] in cand]:\n        health[q] = float(np.clip(t2 / max(med, 1e-6), 0.05, 1.0))\n        m = ObservationMembrane()\n        sc = float(np.clip(1.0 - health[q], 0, 1))\n        flags[q] = m.push(sc); flags[q] = m.push(sc)\n    zz = {}\n    try:\n        for a, b in backend.coupling_map.get_edges():\n            if a in health and b in health:\n                zz[(min(a, b), max(a, b))] = 1.0\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    return cand, health, flags, zz\n\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"EDGE QUANTUM GUARD — PHASE 1 READY\")\nprint(\"Author: Arturo Salvador Balderas Hernandez\")\nprint(\"License: Elastic License 2.0\")\nprint(\"Workload: QSVM (Apache-2.0 pattern)\")\nprint(\"HARDWARE ONLY | budget 15s + 15s = 30s\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"Next → Phase 2 (Arm B: EQG + QSVM on real QPU).\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T06:48:04.504151Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T06:48:04.504497Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T06:48:12.498633Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T06:48:04.504467Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T06:48:12.497669Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Note: you may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\nConnecting to IBM Quantum — HARDWARE ONLY…\n","output_type":"stream"},{"name":"stderr","text":"qiskit_runtime_service._discover_account:WARNING:2026-10-10 06:48:09,041: Loading account with the given token. `HARDWARE_OK` | EQG+QSVM met the gate; baseline compared on real QPU within 30 s account |\n| `B_NOT_FAVORABLE` | EQG+QSVM under-performed; baseline correctly withheld |\n| `B_FAILED` | No usable assisted result; check token, backend, or queue |\n| `B_OK_A_SKIPPED` | Assisted OK but Arm A not run |\n\n**Limitations**\n\n- Hardware claims require a valid IBM token and the same pre-registered thresholds.\n- Kernel estimation uses a fixed tiny dataset so that a full train kernel fits a **15 s** account window; this is a stress test of stability under a real QSVM *pattern*, not a large-scale ML benchmark.\n- Layout selection excludes qubits from *this job’s circuit only*; it does not power-down the device.\n- Queue wall-time can exceed account time on open plans; use `job_id`s in IBM Quantum to track jobs.\n\n**Roles (reminder)**\n\n- **Layout Guard** = who works (configuration).\n- **Conditional DD** = how they work (mitigation), without changing the set.\n- **QSVM** = the
